label: separate-assessment-v1
selection: Maximise valid selected target AND correct intention for that selected target. Compare this same operational metric across combined and split requests. Also report chosen-target intention and each case. Equal scores are a plateau, not proof of improvement. Validation is evaluated once after selection; never used for further tuning.
limitations: Twenty distinct states per split, five/ten-turn initial scrambles, half with two applied subsequent actions. One development case replays actual failure context. Different seeds and no state overlap with prior validation. Split variants make two dependent calls per case. These measure cross-assessment accuracy only, not full-solve reliability.
